description_en: The building is attributed to Bahādura Śāha, the second son of King Pṛthivīnārāyaṇa Śāha. From 1785 to 1794, Bahādura Śāha acted as regent for his juvenile nephew, King Rana Bahādura Śāha. NielsGutschow(2011, 843-847) calls the Bahādura Śāha Bhavana the first "modern building" in Nepal as it broke with traditional Newar architectural conventions. The large double doors that would allow an elephant to pass through are unique as is the upstairs hall that spans 5.4 meters. Probably built in 1790, it was the first structure of such large proportions in the Kathmandu Valley. The building features balconies on either side as well as tall vertical windows with louvers that may have been modelled after the windows of British colonial buildings in Lucknow.The building's roof was restored in the early 1990s with funding from the German Government under the Urban Development through Local Efforts program (UDLE). In 2007, the Kathmandu Valley Preservation Trust carried out a thorough restoration with funding from the American Ambassadors Fund for Cultural Preservation (AFCP). Following the damage suffered in the 2015 earthquakes, KVPT again made use of AFCP funding to repair the northern section of the building.The original function of the building is not known, but it was later used as an armoury. After 1934, it housed the Earthquake Loan branch office. In 1947, the Tripadma Vidyāśrama School opened and from 1973 it has housed the Adarsa Kanya Niketana girl’s school. Maṅgalabajāra Ṭola Sudhāra Samiti has recently been running a music class in its main hall. The building has also been used for exhibitons of the Kathmandu Triennale.
description_ne: मंगःहितिको पूर्वपट्टि बहादुरशाह भवन अवस्थित छ । केशवनारायण चोकको उत्तरी खण्डलाई छुनेगरी यो भवन बनेको छ । यो भवन कहिले र कसले बनायो भनी ठोस रूपमा भन्न सकिने कुनै लिखित प्रमाण पाइएको छैन तथापि पृथ्वीनारायण शाहका दोस्रा छोरा बहादुर शाहले बनाएको हो भन्ने विश्वास रही आएको छ । सन् १७८५ देखि १७९४ सम्म नायवी चलाएका बहादुर शाहले सम्भवतः यसै समयताका यो भवन बनाएका थिए । भवनमा भूमि तल्ला देखि पहिलो तल्लाको मध्य भागसम्म पुग्ने अग्लो ढोका रहेको छ । नेवारी वास्तुशैलीमा बनेका भवनहरूमा यति अग्लो ढोका पाइदैन । यस भवन पछाडि हात्तीसार हुने गर्दथ्यो । हात्तीको सहज आवत–जावतको लागि यसरी अग्लो ढोका बनाइएको हो । पहिलो तल्लमा परम्परागत तिकिझ्याःहरूको प्रयोग भएको छ । त्यसैगरी दोस्रो तल्लामा भने शिसाको प्रयोग भएको आयताकार लाम्चा झ्यालहरू रहेका छन् जसको किनारामा सेतो रङ्गको प्लाष्टर गरिएको छ । सम्भवतः नेवारीवास्तुको वाह्य भागमा प्रयोग भएको यो पहिलो प्लाष्टर हो (Gutschow, 2011: 843) । भवनको माथिल्लो भागमा परम्परागत पेगोडा शैलीको छाना रहेको छ ।यस भवन कुन प्रयोजनको लागि निर्माण भएको थियो भन्ने स्पष्ट छैन तर पछि यसलाई हथियार घर/शस्त्रशाला (armoury) का रूपमा प्रयोग गरियो (KVPT report, 2016) । सन् १९९४ को भूकम्प पछि यस भवनलाई भूकम्प ऋण शाखाका रूपमा सदुपयोग गरियो । त्यसताका यसै भवनबाट भूकम्प पिडितहरूलाई ऋण प्रदान गरिएको थियो । १९५० मा यस भवनमा त्रिपद्म विद्याश्रम खोलियो । त्यसपछि सन् सन् १९७३ मा आदर्श कन्या निकेतन नामक विद्यालय स्थापना गरिएको थियो । गत भूकम्पमा भवनलाई क्षति पुगेपछि सन् २०१६मा KVPT बाट मर्मतकार्य सम्पन्न गरिएको हो । मंगलबजार टोल सुधार समितिले हाल भवनको हलमा परम्परागत बाद्यबादन प्रशिक्षण कार्यक्रमम संचालन गर्दै आएको छ ।

historical_events.event_description: The building is attributed to Bahādur Śāha who acted as the regent from 1785 to 1794.

historical_events.event_name: Use of the building for the Earthquake Loan Branch
historical_events.event_description: After the earthquake of 1934, the building housed the Earthquake Loan Branch in charge of providing loans to those affected by the earthquake.
A school was established in the building.
The building was leased to the Tripadma Vidhyāśrama School.
Ādarśa Kanyā Niketana (Girl's school) was formally established.
The monument was damaged in the 2015 earthquakes.
The monument was restored by the Kathmandu Valley Preservation Trust with funding from the U.S. Ambassadors Fund for Cultural Preservation.
